newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB up after Kleinwort reiterates "buy".
newsitem.headline: BSkyB up after Kleinwort reiterates "buy".

text.p: Shares in British Satellite Broadcasting Plc (BSkyB) were up 9p to 567-1/2p by 0905 GMT after broker Kleinwort Benson reiterated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
"Kleinworts put out a note which said BSkyB's upcoming digital TV service should enhance revenues and reckon the stock could go to 700p," one market maker said.
A spokesman at Kleinwort confirmed that the company rated the BSkyB a "buy" and said the broadcasters new digital service could add about 30 percent to the valuation of the group.
